name: kinoa-qa
description: QA plugin with five skills: testplan builds Allure TestOps test cases from a Jira Story + Confluence PRD + linked Figma mockups, enriched by OpenSpec specs; smoke-plan turns a Story into a Smoke test Jira sub-task; smoke-run runs that sub-task in a browser via the Playwright MCP and reports back to Jira; mcp-plan writes a test plan for a Kinoa MCP story; mcp-run runs that plan against the deployed stand through the kinoa connector and writes the test report. Standalone, decoupled from kinoa-dev.
